chain_trace.break_detail: The break is at the doc link: the contract (and the registry doc_quote) asserts a response grid that its own cited v1.18.x source does not contain; that source instead documents exactly the shape the server served. Script and log links are internally consistent (the script faithfully encoded the constraint text and faithfully reported the raw body; its adjudication note explicitly anticipated 'an undocumented standalone disabled variant would be the by-design defense; no such variant exists in any spec source available to this round' — this forensics supplies the missing spec source: the variant IS documented, on the live page and in every OpenAPI snapshot v1.1.2..v1.18.x in the repo). Corroboration that the defect dissolves rather than being target misbehavior: (a) repo openapi/openapi-cluster.ytt.yaml:4-11 generates GET /cluster -> response reference('ClusterStatus'); (b) that ClusterStatus is generated from the Rust enum in lib/storage/src/types.rs:243-250 whose Disabled variant is the designed single-node disposition; (c) all 8 scripts share the same stale oracle, so the multi-script reproduction is of the observation, not of independent defect confirmation.
